title.narrative: Strengthening the resilience of Russian-speaking audiences in Moldova through deep engagement non news content

description.narrative: The action aims to increase the resilience of Moldovan Russian-speaking audiences to manipulation and polarisation by providing grants (Output 1), through a competitive process,to fund the creation, distribution and marketing of in-demand non-news and socially impactful programming that caters for and resonates with Russian-speaking audience that are vulnerable to Kremlin-aligned information. And by providing capacity building support (Output 2), to invest in and build capacity of independent media creators to serve the needs of Russian-speaking audiences beyond a single funding cycle, with one production creating a pathway to the next, and thus deliver a long-term impact.
